cd.chip.not_linked.import.zh: 尚无 slug：导入时自动选取
cd.chip.not_linked.import.en: No slug yet: picked on import

cd.chip.not_checked.zh: 已设 slug · 尚未检查

cd.chip.live_complete.hint.zh: 部分分集为较早的渲染

cd.chip.live_differs.zh: 已上 CrazyDramas · 时长不一致

cd.chip.live_unverified.zh: 已上 CrazyDramas · 时长未核对

cd.chip.local_newer.zh: 已上 CrazyDramas · 本地文件更新

cd.sub.zh: 此剧集是否已在 crazydramas.com 上线、哪些分集与 Studio 的文件时长一致、免费与付费如何划分。时长一致只说明长度相同，不代表是同一个文件。
cd.sub.en: Whether this title is live on crazydramas.com, which episodes match Studio's files by length, and the free/paid split. A length match proves the same length, not the same file.

cd.series.split.value.zh: 免费 {free} 集 · 付费 {paid} 集

cd.series.poster.placeholder.zh: 占位海报：crazydramas.com 目前显示的是这部剧的占位图。
cd.series.poster.placeholder.en: Placeholder poster: crazydramas.com shows a stand-in image for this series.

cd.notLinked.note.zh: 此剧集还没有 crazydramas slug。打开下方的“上传到 CrazyDramas”时，Studio 会根据剧名生成一个，在 crazydramas 上确认没有被占用，并写进影片的 film-meta。
cd.notLinked.note.en: This title has no crazydramas slug yet. When Upload to CrazyDramas opens below, Studio picks one from the title, checks it is free on crazydramas and writes it into the film's film-meta.

cd.notLinked.notImported.zh: 此剧集还没有 crazydramas slug。打开下方的“上传到 CrazyDramas”时，Studio 会根据剧名生成一个，并在 crazydramas 上确认没有被占用。
cd.notLinked.notImported.en: This title has no crazydramas slug yet. When Upload to CrazyDramas opens below, Studio picks one from the title and checks it is free on crazydramas.

cd.notLive.note.zh: crazydramas.com 对此 slug 返回 404：这部剧未上传，或仍是草稿、已归档。Studio 只读取公开站点，无法区分这几种情况。
cd.notLive.note.en: crazydramas.com answers 404 for this slug: the series is not uploaded, or it is a draft or archived. Studio reads only the public site, so it cannot tell which.

cd.readFailed.note.zh: 上次读取失败（{time}）：{error}。下面显示的是上次成功读取的结果，已标为过期。
cd.readFailed.note.en: The last read failed ({time}): {error}. What is shown below is the last good read, marked stale.

cd.readFailed.none.zh: 上次读取失败（{time}）：{error}。还没有成功读取过。
cd.readFailed.none.en: The last read failed ({time}): {error}. There is no earlier good read.

cd.notChecked.note.zh: 此剧集已设 slug，但还没有读取过 crazydramas.com。后台每小时读取一次；也可以立即检查。
cd.notChecked.note.en: This title carries a slug but crazydramas.com has not been read for it yet. The sweep reads hourly; Check now reads at once.

cd.slugReassigned.note.zh: 这个 slug 现在指向另一部剧，不是当初关联的那部（CMS 里改过 slug）。按未上线处理。
cd.slugReassigned.note.en: This slug now serves another series than the one linked (a rename in the CMS). It is read as not live.

cd.unverified.note.zh: 每一集都在 CrazyDramas 上且已就绪，但 Studio 没有其中某些分集的帧数，无法核对时长。从影片工作区导入的分集才有帧数。
cd.unverified.note.en: Every episode is on CrazyDramas and ready, but Studio holds no frame count for some of them, so their lengths cannot be checked. Frame counts come with an import from the film workspace.

cd.lengthRule.zh: 时长规则：CrazyDramas 分集的时长换算为帧数后，等于 Studio 的帧数 + {offset} 即视为“时长相同”；+1、+3、+4 视为“接近”。这条规则只在一部影片上校准过（{film}，{files} 个文件），在第一次由 Studio 上传的分集确认之前不会阻止任何操作。
cd.lengthRule.en: Length rule: a CrazyDramas episode reads "same length" when its duration in frames is Studio's frame count + {offset}; +1, +3 and +4 read "close". Calibrated on one film only ({film}, {files} files); it blocks nothing until the first Studio-made upload confirms it.

cd.verdict.close.zh: 接近 · 可能是较早的渲染

cd.checked.failed.zh: 上次读取失败于 {time}，尚无成功读取
cd.checked.failed.en: Last read failed {time}; no good read yet

cd.check.tooSoon.zh: 30 秒内已检查过，请稍后再试。
cd.check.tooSoon.en: Checked less than 30 s ago; try again shortly.

cd.check.preview.zh: 工作人员预览模式下不能在此检查，请到工作人员页面操作。
cd.check.preview.en: Staff previewing the portal cannot run a check here; use the staff page.

cd.check.readOnly.zh: 只有审阅和审批角色可以发起检查；其他角色可以查看结果。
cd.check.readOnly.en: Only the reviewer and approver roles can run a check; everyone else can see the result.

cd.unmatched.sub.zh: 已在 crazydramas.com 上线、但没有关联任何 Studio 剧集的剧。导入同名影片时，Studio 会自动关联。
cd.unmatched.sub.en: Series live on crazydramas.com that no Studio title is linked to. Importing a film with the same title links it automatically.

cd.unmatched.empty.zh: 每一部上线的剧都已匹配到 Studio 剧集。
cd.unmatched.empty.en: Every live series matches a Studio title.

cd.unmatched.notRead.zh: 还没有读取过 CrazyDramas 的目录；后台每小时读取一次。
cd.unmatched.notRead.en: The CrazyDramas catalog has not been read yet; the sweep reads it hourly.
